title: [R8-D2-s2-01] PeakTracker averages the top-k metering windows, not the top-k days the capacity tariff bills
body:
tariff.PeakTracker keeps the k highest metering windows regardless of day while the tariffs bill three highest peaks on different days: a cold morning publishes billed_peak_kw 9.80 kW vs true 7.83 kW (+96.37 SEK/month) and threshold_kw 9.60 vs 6.50 kW, so a 9.0 kW hour on another day is priced free while billed 40.83 SEK; over 8 grid months the overbill is 1.42-34.40 SEK/month, mean 19.11, 16.93 with the best cell dropped.

Evidence: tools/audit/round8/D2/s2_distinct_day_peaks.py, command `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tools/audit/round8/D2/s2_distinct_day_peaks.py` -> RESULT headline_overbill_sek=96.3667, grid_overbill_mean_sek=19.114, grid_overbill_mean_drop_max_sek=16.930, plan_overcharge_ratio=3.0; `--k1` -> 0 everywhere. tools/audit/round8/D2/v1_peak_days.py -> median 76.66 SEK/month (upper bound).

Final severity **high**, stop-rule class **bug** (judge-verified).

Proposed fix scope: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/tariff.py; per-day maxima list behind a distinct-days flag. Seam rule: grep -n 'def _close_window\|def billed_peak_kw\|def threshold_kw\|def peak_cost' custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/tariff.py

Related: #926 / #968 (the catalog records Ellevio's three peaks on three different days; PeakTracker never implemented the distinct-day rule), #1210 (solver soft top-k, different code). Distinct from #1499 part (b): that fix changes the kW fed to PeakTracker.observe on no-meter installs; this finding is the aggregation inside PeakTracker and holds with a real meter.

Finding id: D2-s2-01 (round 8, baseline cdf82daa).

title: [R8-D2-s2-02] Entity price sources are read unit-blind: öre/kWh and SEK/MWh prices reach the plan at 83x and 829x
body:
price_model.prices_from_entity_state and Coordinator._pv_export_price never read the sensor's unit, so an öre/kWh or SEK/MWh sensor reaches _price_series at 83.01x / 828.60x the true SEK/kWh and the export price at 100x / 1000x, shrinking the fee share of the spread from 0.13228 to 0.00152 / 0.00015; the plan moves +5.4 kWh on a winter_mild day and published cost is 100x.

Evidence: tools/audit/round8/D2/s2_price_unit.py, command `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tools/audit/round8/D2/s2_price_unit.py` -> RESULT ratio_SEK_per_kWh=1.0000 (null), ratio_ore_per_kWh=83.0147, ratio_SEK_per_MWh=828.6029. Production-side perturbation tools/audit/round8/D2/judge_price_unit_fix.py -> import 1.0000 for all units, export unchanged. tools/audit/round8/D2/v1_price_unit.py -> plan +5.43 kWh, cost 100x.

Final severity **high**, stop-rule class **bug** (judge-verified).

Proposed fix scope: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/price_model.py and coordinator.py; one unit-conversion helper for prices, export and grid-fee reads.

Related: #961 / #919 (temperature inputs adopted as degC whatever the unit; price entities were not in scope).

Finding id: D2-s2-02 (round 8, baseline cdf82daa).

title: [R8-D11-s1-01] A PR body edit re-creates policy-docs, env-matrix and wave-script as skipped check runs at the unchanged head
body:
governance.yml's edited guard makes every body edit create skipped runs for 3 of 16 required contexts at the unchanged head; 3 of 15 merged PRs and 6 of 19 heads carry a skip after a real verdict; 0 reds masked so far.

Evidence: tools/audit/round8/D11/s1_skip_supersede.py, command `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tools/audit/round8/D11/s1_skip_supersede.py --api --clone <full clone>` -> RESULT required_skippable_edited=3, superseded_merged_heads=3, masked_red_heads=0, null 0; `--perturb` -> 0. tools/audit/round8/D11/v1_latest_order.py -> skip latest by id in 18 of 24 pairs.

Final severity **high**, stop-rule class **bug** (judge-weakened from critical).

Proposed fix scope: .github/workflows/governance.yml; split pr-contract into its own workflow and drop edited from the rest.

Regression introduced by the #1474 fix (#1484: github.event.action != 'edited' skips six jobs, and those skipped runs supersede the real verdicts at the same head).

title: [R8-D11-s2-01] Required checks run PR-editable code no CODEOWNERS pattern owns; a one-line edit turns pr-contract green

Required jobs execute 8 unowned files from the PR checkout; a one-line append to any of the 3 policy_lint.mjs loads turns pr-contract's refusal rc 1 into 0, and 5 unowned files flip a required context in total.

Final severity **high**, stop-rule class **bug** (judge-verified).

Proposed fix scope: .github/workflows (restore check source from base), .github/CODEOWNERS, codeowners_gap.py transitive walk.

Regression of #1402 (closed via #1430) and #1403 (fixed by #1434); pr-contract still loads PR-checkout policy_lint.mjs code that no CODEOWNERS pattern owns. Merges D11-s1-02.

title: [R8-D1-s1-01] set_thermal_parameters DHW minimums written during a solve are reverted by the away-setback unwind
body:
A set_thermal_parameters call carrying dhw_min_temperature and dhw_idle_min_temperature that lands while async_run_optimization awaits its solve is applied and acknowledged, then the unconditional away.restore_setback in that method's finally writes the pre-solve values back, with away mode inactive; 2 of 2 written fields are reverted in the live params and 2 of 2 in coordinator.data, and the reverted values feed the next solve.

Evidence: tools/audit/round8/D1/s1_setback_race.py, command `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tools/audit/round8/D1/s1_setback_race.py` -> RESULT race_reverted_live=2, race_reverted_published=2, control_reverted_live=0 (the same call after the cycle returns); perturbation `--perturb` -> 0/0. tools/audit/round8/D1/v1_setback_race.py -> race 2/2, control 0/0, late_next_solve_inputs_reverted=2. Counts only; window width provisional.

Final severity **medium**, stop-rule class **bug** (judge-verified).

Proposed fix scope: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/coordinator.py and away.py; compare-and-restore only fields the setback changed, or apply the setback to the solve snapshot. Seam rule: grep -n 'apply_setback\|restore_setback\|away_original' custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/{coordinator,away}.py

title: [R8-D1-s2-01] A non-numeric kwh/sek leaf in the persisted ledger passes MonthlyLedger.from_dict and fails every refresh cycle
body:
MonthlyLedger.from_dict validates structure but not lines[*].kwh/sek leaves, so a leaf such as sek='12,5' loads and _build_data_dict raises on every refresh: 3 of 3 cycles end with last_update_success False (4 ERROR logs), the setup first refresh raises ConfigEntryNotReady, actuation continues 3 of 3; 81 of 250 seeded mutants (0.324) escape the loader.

Perturbation: leaf guard in from_dict (tools/audit/round8/D1/v1_s2_perturb_runner.py) -> 0.0000; v1_ledger_cycles.py --perturb -> 0. Trigger is a hand edit or storage corruption.

Final severity **medium**, stop-rule class **bug** (judge-weakened from critical).

Proposed fix scope: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/ledger.py MonthlyLedger.from_dict; leaf try/except dropping the month, as accuracy.py/price_model.py/wear.py do.

Related: #1408 (non-finite store-load choke point; a non-numeric leaf is outside it), #238, #773.

Proposed fix scope: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/open_meteo.py; type-check blocks and sequences in _parse_block and keep async_refresh's never-raises contract.

title: [R8-D2-s1-01] The DHW planner prices COP at the current humidity, not the forecast; published DHW runs up to 4.4 K below the correct plan
body:
With a learned humid-bucket defrost derate and a forecast of 85-95 % RH against a current 55 %, the DHW planning seams evaluate COP with humidity=None: the optimizer's DHW schedule re-simulated deviates from the published dhw_temp_trajectory by up to 4.97 K (6 cells, dropped-best 4.89 K), and the published trajectory runs up to 4.41 K below the correctly planned one (dropped-best 3.78 K).

Evidence: tools/audit/round8/D2/s1_dhw_humidity.py, command `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tools/audit/round8/D2/s1_dhw_humidity.py` -> RESULT gap_max=4.9717 K, nulls 0.0000; `--ambient-matches` -> 0.0000 in 6/6. tools/audit/round8/D2/v1_dhw_humidity.py -> shortfall_max=4.4088 K, reverse arm over-buys 0.7927 kWh, null 0.

Final severity **medium**, stop-rule class **bug** (judge-verified).

Proposed fix scope: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/thermal_model.py and optimizer.py; pass per-step humidity at every DHW COP seam. Seam rule: grep -nE 'compute_cop(_dhw)?\(|marginal_cop\(' custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/optimizer.py custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/thermal_model.py | grep -v humidity

When the fork point carries a claim list the diff does not change, env_drift's claim-hygiene check refuses every production mutant before capture while the unmutated tree passes, and mutation_table.run_script scores that as 'killed by tests/env_drift.py': 17 of 17 seeded mutants, including a comment-only edit, are refused.

Final severity **medium**, stop-rule class **bug** (judge-verified).

Proposed fix scope: tests/mutation_table.py env_drift driver (apply the inherited-claims rewrite or judge only the drift section), a comment-only-edit check, and a D3.md note.

Related: #1453, fixed by #1506 after this baseline; its NON_VIOLATION_EXITS is keyed to tests/structure.py only, so an env_drift INHERITED CLAIMS refusal is still scored as a kill.
